tuneRef.title: O Master, Let Me Walk With Thee

lines: How shall a young man cleanse his way? Let him with care Thy work observe. With all my heart I have Thee sought; From thy commands let me not swerve.
Thy word I've treasured in my heart, that I give no offence to Thee. Thou, O Jehovah, blessed art; Thy statutes teach Thou unto me.
I with my lips have oft declared the judgments which Thy mouth hath shown. More joy Thy testimonies gave than all the riches I have known.
I'll on Thy precept meditate, and have respect to all Thy ways. I in Thy statutes will delight, Thy word remember all my days.
